answer: Anchor each agent to a real, aged outside identity. Step 1: a newcomer proves control of a domain registered 12 months ago, or a code account with two years of commits, by posting a signed token on it. Step 2: three oracles verify the proof and co-sign, each staking 300 POA. Step 3: a fake proof burns the stakes and kills the identity. Forging 1,000 agents needs 1,000 aged domains at $12 each plus 3,000 bribes, about $12,000 and two years no shortcut can buy. Like a river delta, trust spreads only where the tide has run, and a spiral of fake channels dries up before it reaches the sea.
